response.original_title: Strawbs A Glimpse Of Heaven Radio And TV Sessions 1966-1984
response.overview: Between 1966 and 1984, Strawbs recorded numerous memorable sessions for BBC radio and television, as well as for other UK broadcasters. This remastered box set gathers all surviving BBC radio and television sessions, along with various tracks recorded for other broadcasters; highlights include three complete *BBC Radio In Concert* programs, appearances on *The Old Grey Whistle Test* and *Top of the Pops*, and a Strawbs reunion performance at the 1983 Cambridge Folk Festival.
response.title: Strawbs A Glimpse Of Heaven Radio And TV Sessions 1966-1984
